original_full_PR218_record.title: Classify quadratic biform ranks and exclude rank 13 in the 3-by-3 block
original_full_PR218_record.body:
This gives an effective rank formula for arbitrary quadratic biforms and a structural restriction on its two kernel indices. In particular, the nonzero fifteen-by-fifteen biform block at a=b=3 has exactly the ranks {9,12,14,15} over every field: rank13 is excluded, and universal witnesses attain the other four values.

After dividing the common coefficient gcd, let D be the largest remaining degree. The two polynomial kernel indices sum to aD, their first nonzero coefficient-kernel degree recovers both, and the full source rank is ab + min(b,mu1) + min(b,mu2). A minimum recurrence vector either has Hankel rank two and degree at least ceil((a-1)D/2), or comes from a rational root of height h and degree (a+1)h. The proof includes zero endpoints, common factors, D=0 and characteristic two.

Claims: AI-QUADRATIC-KERNEL-INDICES-001 and AI-QUADRATIC-INDEX-DICHOTOMY-002, both proof-written-unreviewed. The prior general biform kernel-bundle identity and existing special-family formulas retain their credit. External inputs: Schoemann–Wiedmann arXiv:1712.03056v1, Theorem2.1; De Teran–Dopico–Mackey MIMS EPrint2013.47 (August22 2013), Theorem6.5. Exact source versions, hypotheses and local hashes are recorded in sources.json.

Validation:
- Published verifier compares 2,010 complete source matrices over Q,F2,F3,F5, including every nonzero F2 triple for a=2,3.
- Six original focused tests,18 repository consistency tests and3 integrated top-coefficient tests pass.
- All five frozen archive replays pass; ten source files verified.
- Expanded structural controls pass locally (2,050 source comparisons and10 focused tests); their publication is pending completion of the already-running regression process so its saved input report stays stable.
- Full local regression suite and current required CI remain pending.

Reproduction: python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_quadratic_kernel_indices.py -v; python -m unittest discover -s tests -v; python tools/replay.py.

This is a biform-block result, not a classification of every full cyclic-tensor slice. No source-space cap, compatible three-leg maps, degeneration, independent mathematical review, formalization or exponent improvement is claimed.

original_full_PR218_record.title: Determine general quadratic biform ranks from minimal kernel degrees
original_full_PR218_record.body:
Investigate the general three-polynomial family `u(x)+z*v(x)+z^2*w(x)` in the literal cyclic-source coefficient matrix. The intended result expresses its exact rank through the two minimal degrees of the polynomial recurrence kernel, proves their degree sum after common-factor normalization, and gives a bounded coefficient-matrix procedure to determine them.

This follows the explicitly open general-kernel question in PR #216 and is distinct from PR #217's special top-coefficient family. Earlier affine and constant-endpoint results retain their credit. There is no unmerged runtime dependency.

The initial checkpoint records the question and scope. The all-field proof and independent full-source finite controls are in progress. This is an individual-slice classification, not a source-space cap, constructed matrix target, degeneration, or exponent improvement. Keep this PR in draft until its completed evidence and required checks are recorded.
